mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (id, platform, bot_id, group_id, task_kind, category, status, mandate_source, mandate_ref, creator_user_id, snapshot, wake_condition, schedule_at, expire_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{taskKind}, #{category}, #{status}, #{mandateSource}, #{mandateRef}, #{creatorUserId}, #{snapshot}, #{wakeCondition}, #{scheduleAt}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, task_kind AS taskKind, category, status, mandate_source AS mandateSource, mandate_ref AS mandateRef, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, snapshot, wake_condition AS wakeCondition, schedule_at AS scheduleAt, expire_at AS expireAt, result, error_code AS errorCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, task_kind AS taskKind, category, status, mandate_source AS mandateSource, mandate_ref AS mandateRef, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, snapshot, wake_condition AS wakeCondition, schedule_at AS scheduleAt, expire_at AS expireAt, result, error_code AS errorCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM task WHERE status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'WAITING') AND schedule_at <= #{now} ORDER BY schedule_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, task_kind AS taskKind, category, status, mandate_source AS mandateSource, mandate_ref AS mandateRef, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, snapshot, wake_condition AS wakeCondition, schedule_at AS scheduleAt, expire_at AS expireAt, result, error_code AS errorCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM task WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, task_kind AS taskKind, category, status, mandate_source AS mandateSource, mandate_ref AS mandateRef, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, snapshot, wake_condition AS wakeCondition, schedule_at AS scheduleAt, expire_at AS expireAt, result, error_code AS errorCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM task WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'WAITING')

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, task_kind AS taskKind, category, status, mandate_source AS mandateSource, mandate_ref AS mandateRef, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, snapshot, wake_condition AS wakeCondition, schedule_at AS scheduleAt, expire_at AS expireAt, result, error_code AS errorCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM task WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND task_kind = 'light' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_execution_log (task_id, record_kind, note) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{recordKind}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, record_kind AS recordKind, note, created_at AS createdAt FROM task_execution_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_output_archive (task_id, chunk_index, chunk_text) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkText})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, chunk_index AS chunkIndex, chunk_text AS chunkText, created_at AS createdAt FROM task_output_archive WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY chunk_index
